id./param/scenario/cs/b_100_cs_090.pack|cs_: "Brother, you're amazing... Thanks for saving the village from the dragon.
"Ugh, ugh... Miko was eaten by the man-eating fire dragon. Hotto is finished...
"Miko and Ryu both gone. Who will protect us now...
"Miko... Why did she protect the man-eating dragon that attacked the village so desperately?
"...I don't want to know about someone who betrayed everyone! Who cares about that!
"Brother! More importantly, we must chase the fled dragon quickly! If left alone, it will attack the village again!
"Remember where we first met? Past the mountain gate beyond that path, we should reach the dragon's lair!
"Miko's maid should have the gate key. Let's go to Miko's shrine, brother!"
